name: Research A v2: thinking against non-thinking at matched supervised tokens and composition
status: REGISTERED 2026-10-31 at $0, before any supplementary generation and before any student result was read; DATA ONLY: this design authorizes supplementary teacher generation and the data admission, never a search, an initialization, a training run or an evaluation (the D4 full search and the training are proposals that wait for the maintainer's review)

decided_by.maintainer: 2026-10-31 'Research A Immediate STOP and Token-Matched Data Completion': stop the recovery; the training scale is supervised tokens, not packed sequences; per mode 5,923,021 = 2,960,507 (the category corresponding to D4-Augmented's base corpus) + 2,962,514 (fluid reasoning); matched totals, category ratio and comparable source distribution; reuse every legal sealed record first; stop after the data and wait for review
decided_by.maintainer_choice: 2026-10-31 (question in session): the base-corpus category corresponds to E1's corpus_v2 type by type -- competition math (MATH train, replacing openmath), GSM8K train, SQuAD v2 answerable reading, HotpotQA multi-hop reading, code -- one fifth each; tool calling has no legal training source and is dropped; answerability is not counted
decided_by.maintainer_2: 2026-10-31 'Research A STOP, Token-Matched data completion and D4 Full Search plan review' (supersedes the first 2026-10-31 brief): the same token targets; match totals, categories and source/family distributions as closely as possible; the new study's initialization is a NEW D4 full search on the hybrid teacher's frozen weights with D4's search specification and freshly computed hybrid calibration references -- proposed now, not executed; every arm and both seeds start from its one Top-1
decided_by.maintainer_3: Maintainer 2026-10-31 'Teacher–Student Lineage Invariant and Final 3×2 Training Matrix': a student starts from ITS OWN teacher's weights through the approved initialization and is distilled by the same teacher lineage; the final matrix is three arms x two seeds (20260726, 20260801): A1 = the new hybrid D4 full-search Top-1, KD and data from the hybrid in thinking mode; A2 = the same Top-1, the hybrid in non-thinking mode; C1 = the historical Thinking-2507 D4 Top-1 (single-shard sha256 fc28e0dd...), KD from Thinking-2507, D4-Augmented's own data; B1/B2, D1/D2, same-tasks and every other arm are cancelled; lineage gates fail closed

supersedes.for_new_work: configs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/d4_scale_design.json (study 848f6508..., the 2,468-sequence target); it stays frozen as Research A v1 and its records, preregistration and student results keep their identity
supersedes.not_reinterpreted: Research A v1's six units (runs/a_recovery_20261030_211948) are historical evidence of v1; none is a result of this design

question: One hybrid teacher (Qwen/Qwen3-4B@1cfa9a72) in its two official modes, H-T (enable_thinking=True) and H-N (enable_thinking=False). At the same number of unique supervised tokens and the same category and cell composition, which mode's teacher-native documents give the 596M student better fluid-reasoning correctness on eval-set-1? A same-tasks comparison is reported beside it, never merged with it.
teacher: unchanged from Research A v1: configs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/teacher_identity.json; the generation protocol's modes, sampling, stop ids, allowance and candidate rule (generation_protocol.json) apply to every supplementary record unchanged

scale.measure: unique supervised tokens: the generated tokens of an admitted token-native document (`len(output_ids)`), the positions CE and KD train on; packed 8,192-token sequences are a consequence, never the target
scale._reference: D4-Augmented (h1pa.json :: arms.D4-Augmented): E1's 1,944 corpus_v2 sequences = 2,960,507 supervised tokens, the H1-PA fluid increment = 2,962,514 (logs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/audit/h1pa_fluid_whole_units.json)

tolerance.rule: whole tasks only (an episode with all its turns); each category stops at the first task boundary that reaches its target, so the only excess is the last task's natural length; a shortfall is reported, never filled from another category or cell

scale.never: padding, repeated samples, repeated epochs to reach a count, cut or concatenated traces, re-rendered generations, a lowered correctness standard

base_counterpart.what: the verified, legally trainable counterpart of each corpus_v2 type in E1's 2,960,507 tokens (E1 held each type at 1/6 by supervised tokens: logs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/audit/token_matched_supply.json :: e1_reference)
base_counterpart.not: knowledge reasoning: none of these is closed-book factual recall. Math and code are learned procedures; SQuAD and HotpotQA reading answers from evidence supplied in the prompt. They are P10.2 supporting capabilities

competition_math.e1_type: openmath (OpenMathInstruct-2 augmented MATH-style problems; key = Llama-3.1-405B majority vote, not a human gold)
competition_math.verifier: boxed_math against MATH train's human gold

rag_reading.e1_type: rag_evidence (SQuAD v2 train answerable, corpus_v2's RAG_PROMPT)
rag_reading.verifier: span: the normalized gold span in the final answer; an answer that opens with an abstention is refused

multihop_reading.verifier: span (a yes/no gold leading the answer)

code.verifier: MBPP: every declared assert in the dev-box sandbox; reasoning_core: the module's comparator or project checker
code.split: MBPP train is exhausted (its 474 eligible tasks are all generated): its cell is capped at the smaller of the two modes' admitted MBPP supervised tokens, and the type's remainder is reasoning_core's code modules, the code stratum's registered construction (order_v1's substitution once MBPP ran out)

tool_calling.why: no legal training source: xLAM is research-purposes-only and DeepSeek-generated, glaive's provenance is undocumented (configs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/sources.json :: evaluation only); its sixth is spread equally over the five types above

base_counterpart.excluded_supply: Research A v1's supporting cells outside these types -- answerability (SQuAD v2 unanswerable; E1 had none), mathematics_dataset and reasoning_gym math (procedural, not E1's competition problems), reasoning_gym code (no task admitted in either mode) -- are audited and reported, never trained here

fluid.what: P10.2's primary strata, each cell at its share of D4-Augmented's fluid increment (h1pa_fluid_whole_units.json :: admission.admitted_mixture)
fluid.prontoqa: D4's deduction/prontoqa share (0.046317) is spread over the deduction stratum's other three cells in proportion to their D4 shares: H-N admits none of its 575 ProntoQA tasks (the contract requires a verified step chain, which the non-thinking answers do not give), so the cell cannot be matched and is dropped from BOTH modes
fluid.abstract_analogical/reasoning_core: not a D4 cell (share 0): its v1 supply is audited, not trained

selection.reuse_first: within a cell, tasks in the order T0 (its lists' order), then order_v1's E and X positions, then order_v2's own cell position; a (task, mode) already sealed is never generated again
selection.verdict: admission.py's frozen per-(task, mode) verdict (verified correct, naturally terminated, protocol-valid, token-native documents under the mode's generation prompt; MBPP in the dev-box sandbox) and its isolation recheck (R1, R2, R9 against eval-set-1, then every rule over the rest), with this study's source catalogue extension
selection.rule: per mode and per category: a largest-remainder interleave over the category's cells on supervised tokens (the next task comes from the cell furthest below its share of the category's running total) until the category reaches its target; each cell is then within one task of its share. A cell exhausted before its category stops is a SHORTFALL: the selection is refused, never substituted
selection.excluded_from_training: V (order_v1's validation slice) and V2 (order_v2's validation slice): validation only
selection.nothing_read: no student result, no eval-set-1 item, no length or score beyond the frozen verdict
selection.family: inside a cell, the next task comes from the family furthest below its target share of the cell's running total; the target is the mean of the two modes' admitted-supply family shares in that cell (by supervised tokens; symmetric, fixed at admission from the sealed records, never from a student result). A family that runs dry hands its remainder to the cell's other families in proportion; per cell the family distribution of each mode and their total-variation distance are reported

supplement.order: artifacts/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/tasks/order_v2.jsonl.gz (build_supplement_tasks.py; outside git, bound by its sha256 in data/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/tasks/order_v2.manifest.json): one queue per cell needing supply, every task new -- a fresh project seed block, new third-party export seed bases, the datasets in their own row order past every task an earlier pool or order holds -- and R0-R9, eval-set-1 and calibration isolation before any generation
supplement.need: per (mode, cell): the cell's quota minus its admitted supervised tokens in the sealed v1 records (dev-box exact, logs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/data/supplement_plan.json)
supplement.generation: rounds on the pod (supplement_session.py): each round takes, per (mode, cell) still short by the pod's lower bound, the next tasks of the cell's queue sized from the cell's measured yield; pass 0, then pass 1 for each first candidate the pod rejects; until every (mode, cell) bound reaches its need x (1 + pod_margin) or the cell's queue is exhausted. Seed base 20261031 (+ pass), new task ids: no (task, mode, candidate) seed repeats v1's
supplement.family_skip: a family with no admitted task in a mode over at least 25 generated tasks in the sealed v1 records is not generated again in that mode (supplement_plan.json :: skip); a family with none in either mode is not built into order_v2 at all. Both are reported. Nothing else about a family is read
supplement.sizing: each round sizes a (mode, cell)'s next batch from the cell's measured admitted tokens per generated task in that mode, times 1.25

validation: per mode, the admitted documents of V and V2 (32 tasks of each new dataset cell), document-isolated at 8,192, at most 16 sequences: diagnostic only
packing: aadistill.data.token_documents.pack_isolated (document_isolated) at 8,192, documents sorted by doc id, order seed 20261029 (generation_protocol.json :: stopping)

A1.initialization: the hybrid D4 full-search Top-1 (to be searched)
A1.data: the H-T token-matched selection, about 5.923M unique supervised tokens

C1.data: D4-Augmented's own pack (5,923,021), hash-verified, no hybrid data

comparisons.A1_vs_A2: the primary comparison: the same hybrid teacher, the same initialization, matched unique supervised tokens and category/cell composition; NOT matched compute

comparisons.A1_vs_C1: end to end, the hybrid route against the Thinking-2507 route; not a single-variable causal contrast
comparisons.cancelled: the same-tasks arms and every other control (maintainer 2026-10-31)
comparisons.not_the_same: token-matched, step-matched and FLOPs-matched are different comparisons; only the matrix above is registered

compute_accounting: per arm: unique supervised tokens, documents, tasks, packed sequences, non-padding tokens, padding share, optimizer steps, supervised-token exposure, student and teacher FLOPs (logs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/data/token_matched_admission.json)

initialization.shared_by: A1 and A2, both seeds, bound by the Top-1's artifact digest

lineage.invariant: Root Teacher -> Calibration -> Full Search -> Student Initialization -> Teacher-native training data -> Online KD teacher -> recovery checkpoint: one teacher lineage (model id, revision, weight hashes, tokenizer, vocabulary, chat template, RoPE/model config) end to end

hybrid.modes: thinking and non-thinking are two official modes of ONE set of weights: A1 and A2 share the one Top-1 of a mode-balanced hybrid full search

lineage.never: a student initialized from one lineage distilled by, or trained on data of, the other; a warning in place of a refusal
lineage.gates: configuration validation, launch admission and the trainer at runtime (proposed with the training plan; nothing trains in this round)
